statement: FLINT/Arb certifies thirteen finite Paper C production roots, the twelve canonical models and Theorem 5.20's five actual productions, in rational brackets of width at most 10^-24; positive fixed-OOEE recurrence slack at 5/8 and positive five-production slack at 37/50; and forty-eight integer rate crossings (six contagion regimes, Chernoff and Azuma, q=1/2,11/20,3/5,31/50). For the log-mass bound at 5/8, kernel-checked in Lean, every integer C from 5 through the first strict rate crossing of 3/8 is checked: Chernoff minima 16,34,168,1135; Azuma minima 16,34,175,1201. For Theorem 5.20 at 37/50, whose one written input is Paper B's Theorem 6.3, the crossings of 13/50 are Chernoff 14,27,128,820 and Azuma 14,28,132,866, each checked from C=5. The elementary Lean baseline 100/203 retains 19 and 41 at the first two caps. Exact rational inputs, outward endpoints, precision escalation and run provenance replace point-value evidence for these expressions only. No production hypothesis, asymptotic error bound, model eigenvalue, Lean proof, or termination result is established; Paper B's Theorem 6.3 retains its review boundary.
